title: Hell is Us

releaseOverride.note: delayed from October 8; the US eShop still lists the old date

summary: Hell is Us is Nacon's third-person action-adventure from Rogue Factor, priced at $59.99 on Switch 2. The Switch 2 version was delayed from October 8 to October 27, 2026 for logistical and distribution reasons, not technical ones, according to the developer. The US eShop lists a 23.7 GB download, and the physical edition is a Game-Key Card: the cartridge holds no game data, so you must download the full game after inserting it. Nacon has not published resolution or frame-rate targets. Early reviews describe the port as playable but rough: Nintendo Life (7/10) points to pop-in, a short draw distance and regular slowdown, and Gamersyde saw frame-rate drops below 30 FPS. The eShop lists 11 languages, including Spanish.
